request: In the WPS Register (WPS No, Process, Thickness Min, Thickness Max, Remark) write Range? in Remark for every WPS where Thickness Min or Thickness Max is blank or not a number, or where the minimum is bigger than the maximum, and clear the Remark on the others. Tell me how many I marked.

In the GRN sheet (GRN No, Part No, Ordered Qty, Received Qty, Receipt Status) put a formula in the Receipt Status column for every data row that shows Complete when Received Qty is at least Ordered Qty and Open otherwise. Excel 2016 only.

Add a sheet called Qual Check to the workbook if it isn't there yet. In A1 write Expired quals and in B1 put a formula that counts how many Expiry Date cells in the Welder Quals sheet (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date) are before today, so it stays right when the sheet changes. Running it again must not add a second sheet.

In the NCR Register (NCR No, Issue Date, Close Date, Days Open) put a formula in Days Open for every data row: Close Date minus Issue Date when there is a Close Date, otherwise today minus Issue Date. Excel 2016 only.

On the Welder Quals sheet (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date, Remark) find the welder ID I give the macro and write Renewal requested in the Remark of the first row with that ID. Tell me the row, or 0 if the welder isn't on the sheet.

On the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Customer, Planned Date, Actual Date) hide every row whose Customer is not the customer name I give the macro, so only that customer's dispatches show. Names are typed in any case and with stray spaces. Tell me how many rows are visible below the headings; running it again for another customer must show that customer's rows.

List on an Open Points sheet every point of the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Inspection Status, Planned Date) that is not Closed, the earliest Planned Date first, with the same headings. Points with no Planned Date go at the end. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

On an Expiring Quals sheet list every qualification in Welder Quals (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date) that has expired or expires in the next 60 days, with the same headings plus a Days Left column (negative when already expired), the soonest first. Rows with no Expiry Date are skipped. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

In the GRN sheet (GRN No, Part No, Received Date, Received Qty, Inspection, Remark) write Inspection pending in Remark for every line received more than 7 days ago whose Inspection is blank, and clear the Remark on the others. Tell me how many lines are pending.

In the NCR Register (NCR No, Severity, Status, Disposition) colour the NCR No cell orange for every NCR that is Closed but has no Disposition. Take the old colour off the NCR No cells first so it can be run again, and tell me how many I coloured.

In the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Customer, Planned Date, Actual Date, Remark) write Late in Remark when the Actual Date is after the Planned Date, Overdue when there is no Actual Date and the Planned Date is before today, and clear the Remark on the others. Tell me how many are Late or Overdue together.

From the NDE Report (Weld Seam No, Method, Result) make a Method Summary sheet with each Method, how many welds were tested and how many have the Result Reject, methods A to Z. RT and rt are the same method; rows with no method are ignored. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Inspection Status) make an ITP Status sheet with one row per ITP No and three columns: how many of its points are Open, Hold and Closed (any case, stray spaces). Any other status is not counted. ITP numbers A to Z. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

From the GRN sheet (GRN No, Supplier, Received Qty) make a Supplier Receipts sheet with each supplier, its number of GRN lines and its total Received Qty, the biggest total first. 'Acme Steel' and 'ACME STEEL ' are the same supplier. Lines with no supplier are ignored, and a Received Qty that is not a number is left out of the total but the line still counts. The sheet is rebuilt every run.

A dispatch readiness tool, started with one macro. (1) In the Job Tracker (Job ID, Customer, Status, Dispatch Flag) write Dispatched in Dispatch Flag for every job that has a row with an Actual Date in the Dispatch sheet (Dispatch No, Job ID, Planned Date, Actual Date), Ready for every other job whose Status is Complete, and clear it on the rest. (2) On a Ready To Ship sheet list the Ready jobs with the same headings, Job IDs A to Z. (3) On a Customer Dispatches sheet write each Customer with how many of its jobs are Dispatched, customers A to Z. (4) Tell me how many jobs are Ready. Job IDs are typed with stray spaces and in mixed case. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.

A welder performance tool, started with one macro. (1) On a Welder Performance sheet write each Welder ID from the NDE Report (Weld Seam No, Welder ID, Result) with how many welds were tested and how many were Reject, the most rejects first. (2) In Welder Quals (Welder ID, Process, Expiry Date, Remark) write Review in Remark for every row whose welder has more than 2 rejects, Expired where the qualification has expired, and clear Remark on the others; Review wins when both apply. (3) On an Expired Quals sheet list the expired qualifications with the same headings, oldest first. (4) Tell me how many rows I marked Review. The output sheets are rebuilt every run.

Compare the GRN sheet (GRN No, Part No, Received Qty) with the BOM (Part No, Required Qty, Received Total, Remark). In the BOM fill Received Total with the total received for each part (0 when nothing was received) and write Short in Remark when that is less than Required Qty, clearing the Remark otherwise. Part numbers differ in case and stray spaces. Quantities that are not numbers are left out. Tell me how many parts are Short.

Check the ITP Tracker (ITP No, Point, Weld Seam No, Inspection Status) against the NDE Report (Weld Seam No, Method, Result). In the ITP Tracker write NDE missing in an NDE Check column for every point whose Weld Seam No has no row in the NDE Report, NDE reject when any of its NDE rows has the Result Reject, and clear it on the others. A point with no Weld Seam No is left alone. Add the heading if it's missing, and tell me how many points need attention.

In the NCR Register (NCR No, Department, Status) the Status cells are typed every which way. Make every status that reads open (any case, stray spaces) read exactly Open, and every one that reads closed or close read exactly Closed. Leave other statuses and blank cells alone, change no other column, and tell me how many cells I changed.

For every line of the GRN sheet (GRN No, Delivery Note File, Copy Status) copy the file named in Delivery Note File from the Inbox folder into a folder named after the GRN No inside the GRN Archive folder (two folder paths I give the macro), making that folder if it isn't there. Write Copied, Already there, Missing or Bad name in Copy Status. Never overwrite, move or delete a file.
